ai.title: mizorewww/laya-mlx
ai.desc: 适用于 Laya 类型化决策模型的原生 MLX 运行时——在 M3 Max 上完成简短决策仅需 7–14 毫秒。无需文本生成、PyTorch 或云 API。
ai.desc_en: Native MLX runtime for Laya typed decision models — 7–14 ms short decisions on M3 Max. No text generation, PyTorch, or cloud API.

ai.title: qwdwqfwq/topconf-paper-figure-gallery
ai.desc: 精选自ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS、CVPR、ACL、AAAI（2023-2026年）的3,516张图1/预览图，附带分级徽章，并采用FigureForge检索增强型图稿绘制技术
ai.desc_en: 3,516 curated Figure 1 / teasers from ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, AAAI (2023-2026), with tier badges and FigureForge retrieval-augmented figure drafting

ai.title: wfzyx/von
ai.desc: 开源的 System One 决策模型。响应时间低于 15 毫秒，非自回归，可直接替代 TypeSafe Jev 的本地解决方案。
ai.desc_en: The open-source System One decision model. Sub-15ms, non-autoregressive, local drop-in alternative to TypeSafe Jev.

ai.title: AbdelStark/awesome-typesafe-jev
ai.desc: 《Awesome Jev》：一本基于源代码的《TypeSafe》System One 模型实用指南，包含 SDK、实时演示、代理工具以及独立评估报告。
ai.desc_en: Awesome Jev: a source-backed field guide to TypeSafe's System One model, with SDKs, live demos, agent tools, and independent evaluations.

ai.title: Sidiora-Labs/Paxeer-X-Network
ai.desc: Paxeer X 是一款用于支付、代码执行和意图路由的分布式超状态机。它专为机器及其操作者而设计。
ai.desc_en: Paxeer X is a Distributed HyperState Machine for payments, code execution and intent routing. Designed for Machines and the Users operating them.

ai.title: strands-labs/strands-decider
ai.desc: 一个适用于主动型工作流的小型、快速决策模型，即“系统一”模型。它能在比大型语言模型（LLM）更快的速度下在选项间进行选择或在量表上进行评分，并且对每项决策都提供经过校准的置信度。
ai.desc_en: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.

ai.title: muellerberndt/cadence
ai.desc: 一个从真实体验中学习的大脑。默认启用“系统1”：感知、记忆、可塑性和行动。可选的“系统2”用于自我观察和缓慢的修正。
ai.desc_en: A brain that learns from live experience. System 1 by default: perception, memory, plasticity and action. Optional System 2 for self-observation and slow corrections.

ai.title: TrenTorch/TrenTorch
ai.desc: 不要死记硬背机器学习。要从第一性原理出发去理解它，包括推理、CUDA、深度学习、数据科学和强化学习。
ai.desc_en: Don't memorize ML. Understand it from first principles including Inference, Cuda, Deep Learning, Data Science and Reinforcement Learning

ai.title: Adkid-Zephyr/oral-paper-skill
ai.desc: 向顶会优秀论文学科研｜Oral Paper Skill — 从 883 篇 Oral 论文摘要中“蒸馏”共通做法，用于论文对照改进与学习复盘 · Skill + prompt pack (CN/EN). Learn from 883 Oral paper abstracts to improve your research and writing.

ai.title: jrz97619761/test-model-thing
ai.desc: 一个小型概念验证语言模型（非大型语言模型），旨在整合潜空间预测、利用递归迹单元实现的内部状态以及逐字节输出，由MLX构建而成。
ai.desc_en: A small proof-of-concept language model (not an LLM) that aims to incorporate latent-space prediction, internal state using recurrent trace units, and byte-by-byte output, built with MLX.

ai.title: zorost/AI-Engineering-Lab
ai.desc: 一门免费的、可自主安排学习进度的24周人工智能工程课程：涵盖Python、机器学习、大型语言模型（LLMs）、RAG、微调、智能体与MCP、Azure、Vertex和Bedrock，以及Databricks。包含43个可运行的笔记本，以及一个贯穿始终的案例研究。 采用MIT许可协议，无需注册。由Zorost Intelligence AI Lab提供。
ai.desc_en: A free, self-paced 24-week AI engineering course: Python, machine learning, LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, agents and MCP, Azure and Vertex and Bedrock, and Databricks. 43 runnable notebooks, one continuous case study. MIT licensed, no signup. By Zorost Intelligence AI Lab.

ai.title: Simreal-AI/Simreal-MLBench
ai.desc: [公开预览] 外部评分型自主机器学习研究基准：60个任务，真实竞赛的 ground truth。开放协议，运营式评估。
ai.desc_en: [Public preview] Externally scored agentic ML research benchmark: 60 tasks, real competition ground truth. Open protocol, operated evaluation.

ai.title: Heman10x-NGU/openJev-verdict-2.0
ai.desc: 经过调优的 151M 非自回归决策引擎在 LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions 数据集上超越了 TypeSafe Jev & Laya（准确率 77.10%，布里尔系数 0.0636，误分类率 0.0144）
ai.desc_en: Calibrated 151M Non-Autoregressive Decision Engine beating TypeSafe Jev & Laya on LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions (77.10% acc, 0.0636 Brier, 0.0144 ECE)

ai.title: fstandhartinger/jevbench
ai.desc: Benchmark Heaven 推出的 JevBench：一款针对 AI 决策模型的基准测试和排行榜工具，用于衡量决策类型准确率、校准、延迟和成本。
ai.desc_en: JevBench by Benchmark Heaven: benchmark and leaderboard for AI decision models, measuring typed decision accuracy, calibration, latency and cost.

ai.title: NiluK/worldmodels101
ai.desc: 关于人工智能中世界模型的免费互动课程。共九个图文并茂的章节，内容涵盖预测、潜在动力学、规划、JEPA、视频模型以及故障模式。
ai.desc_en: Free interactive course on world models in AI. Nine visual chapters on prediction, latent dynamics, planning, JEPA, video models, and failure modes.
